observations.finding: The body score has staffDef s1 and s2 without lines=5. In Verovio 6.3.0 the unmodified source renders without normal staff lines. A temporary diagnostic copy adding only those attributes renders normal staves.

Opening slur in the source MEI spans pickup C3 d1e60 to C4 d1e619 in label 3, whereas the selected print has a slur from the pickup to F3 d1e338 in label 2, followed by a separate slur in label 3 from Bb3 d1e561 to A3 d1e634. Treat the print as the witness when preparing the exercise.
The print shows an f at the start of the second system (musical bar 5, source MEI label 6); the source MEI has no dynamic in label 6.
Verovio 6.3.0 reports 20 slurs not stored in the measure containing their start. Moving a slur to the starting measure is separate from deciding its correct endpoints.
The two opening four-bar phrases are written out in the print and represented by labels 2–5 and 6–9. Do not replace them with an assumed repeat.
